Definition: Cushi, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Cushi is the name of two Israelites, and both appear in the record by their sons. In Jeremiah 36:14 Cushi is the ancestor of Jehudi, who is sent to fetch Baruch and the roll; in Zephaniah 1:1 Cushi is the father of the prophet Zephaniah, named at the head of his book.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the two Cushis show how God keeps a family line: one man's son is sent to fetch the roll, another man's son carries the word of the Lord, and both are remembered by their father's name.
RelatedPeople: Cushi, Father of Zephaniah; Jehudi; Zephaniah
